title: CalibCause: A Quality-Gated, Interpretable and Calibrated Deep Learning Framework for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
abstract: arXiv:2610.40699v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Most deep learning systems for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading are evaluated on a single data source, with limited evidence of cross-site generalisation, uncertainty calibration, and interpretability. We propose CalibCause, a quality-gated mixture-of-experts framework that combines per-expert visual explanations, label-free image-quality conditioning, knowledge distillation, and calibrated confidence with deferral. We evaluated the framework using 51,310 fundus images from EyePACS, DDR, and APTOS 2019, with IDRiD and DeepDRiD for external testing. Evaluation included pooled testing, leave-one-environment-out experiments, paired bootstrap confidence intervals, and local grade-threshold adaptation. On the pooled test split, the label-free distilled student achieved quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.863 and accuracy of 0.865 with 27.8 million parameters, 52% fewer than its teacher. translated_abstract: 大多数用于糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级的深度学习系统仅在单一数据源上进行评估，在跨站点泛化、不确定性校准和可解释性方面的证据有限。我们提出了CalibCause，这是一个质量门控的混合专家框架，结合了每个专家的视觉解释、无标签的图像质量调节、知识蒸馏以及带转诊机制的校准置信度。我们使用来自EyePACS、DDR和APTOS 2019的51,310张眼底图像对该框架进行了评估，并使用IDRiD和DeepDRiD进行外部测试。评估包括合并测试、留一环境外推实验、配对自举置信区间以及本地分级阈值自适应。在合并测试集上，无标签蒸馏学生模型实现了0.863的二次加权Kappa（QWK）和0.865的准确率，参数量仅为2780万，比其教师模型减少了52%。在留出的测试环境中，该无标签模型……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出了CalibCause框架，通过质量门控混合专家、逐专家视觉解释、无标签图像质量调节、知识蒸馏以及带转诊机制的校准置信度，在多个数据源的糖尿病视网膜病变分级任务中实现了强跨站点泛化能力，且学生模型参数量比教师模型减少52%。
